notes.text: This BM record is one accession for a three-part dance costume (head-piece, bodice and skirt). Preserve the group as catalogued; do not create part-level object records without supported separate identities. The catalogue labels this combined field “Found/Acquired”; it is retained as source wording and is not treated as an independently established findspot. A separate “Production place” field is represented as made_at when present.
